subject: System Design
title: TikTok's Recommendation Engine
description: A quick, practical guide to TikTok's Recommendation Engine.

hook.text: TikTok shows you videos you'll love from creators you've never heard of. The algorithm knows you better than you do.

buildup.text: TikTok's For You page uses collaborative filtering and content signals: watch time, replays, shares, and skips.

discovery.text: Watch time is the strongest signal. If you watch 95% of a video, TikTok shows you more like it immediately.

twist.text: New users get diverse content. The algorithm narrows as it learns. Within 30 minutes of use, it knows your taste.

climax.text: TikTok proved that recommendations drive engagement more than the social graph. Content matters more than followers.

punchline.text: Watch time tells the algorithm what you really like.

quiz.question: What is TikTok's strongest recommendation signal?
options: Watch time — how much of a video you actually watch
Number of followers the creator has
